## Review checklist

- [ ] I followed `REVIEWING.md` for every affected surface.
- [ ] I added or updated a deterministic regression check.
- [ ] I kept catalog content and category behavior data-driven.
- [ ] I reviewed privacy and migration impact for stored data.
- [ ] I verified keyboard and accessibility behavior for UI changes.
- [ ] I updated third-party notices when source content changed.
